source: Pew Research Center. 2016. "One-in-Five U.S. Adults Were Raised in Interfaith Homes."
method: Population is current religious tradition (reltrad), among ever-married respondents (qd6a's own skip pattern). Cutpoint is top box ("very important") on qd6a (how important the spouse's religion was in deciding to marry them); don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted (this recontact reached only 5,000 of the main 2014 RLS's 35,071 respondents). Weighted by the dataset's own `rweight` variable.
